name: Buddy Fairchild
bio: Archetype: Ultimate DPT, Buff Buildup. ⌽ Gains [Friendship Badge] when using skills or when an ally uses an Ultimate. ⌽ Increases ATK and Ult damage scaling based on [Friendship Badge] stacks. ⌽ If at max [Friendship Badge] at turn start, gains Moxie. Ult does not cost AP and is guaranteed to Crit. ⌽ After using Ult, grants additional DMG Bonus to all allies.
